privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.scope: Applies to the Kolo Sets website and web app
summary: No ads, no tracking, and we never sell your data.
We store what the app needs: your account, your word sets and your learning progress.
You can export your sets or delete your account from the app at any time.

sections.title: Who we are
blocks: Kolo Sets (“Kolo”, “we”, “us”) is a web application for learning vocabulary in foreign languages with flashcards, spaced repetition and games, available at **{site}**.
The data controller responsible for your personal data is **{operator}**. Contact us about anything in this policy at {email.privacy}.

sections.title: What we collect and why
blocks: We only collect what is needed to run Kolo:

rows: **Account:** email address, password (stored only as a secure hash by Firebase Authentication — we never see it), display name. With Google sign-in: name, email and profile picture from your Google account.
Create your account, sign you in and keep it secure.
Identify you on the daily puzzle leaderboard.
Show your avatar in the app.

**Learning data:** word sets and cards, review schedule, study history, statistics, streaks, achievements and daily goal; XP and level, weekly orbits and shields, capsules, virtual items, stardust and medals.
Run the training modes, schedule reviews and sync your progress between devices.
Show the leaderboard to other signed-in users.
**Support messages:** subject, message, the email you enter (optional) and your account email if you are signed in.
Answer your request and fix the problems you report.
**Record of acceptance:** which version of the Terms and this policy you accepted, and when.
Be able to show what you agreed to.
**Technical data:** IP address, browser and device information.
Protect accounts (Firebase Authentication) and deliver the website (hosting).

blocks: Kolo also keeps some data in your browser — your sign-in session, settings and a local copy of your sets. See the [Cookie Policy](/cookies).

list: We don't show ads or use advertising identifiers.
We don't use analytics or tracking tools. If we ever add analytics, it will run only after you opt in, and we will update this policy first.
We don't sell or rent your personal data, and we don't use it for profiling.
We don't collect precise location, contacts or biometric data.

sections.title: Who can see or process your data
blocks: We use a few service providers. Each processes data only to provide its service:

list: **Google** (Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Storage) — accounts, database and profile photos. [Firebase privacy](https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy)
**Netlify** — hosting and delivery of the website, and the server functions that record your progress and rewards. [Netlify privacy](https://www.netlify.com/privacy/)
**Telegram** — delivers messages you send through the support form to our team's private chat. [Telegram privacy](https://telegram.org/privacy)
**Google Sign-In** — only if you choose to sign in with Google.

**Your browser's speech engine** — pronunciation uses the speech synthesis built into your browser. Depending on the browser, the text may be processed by your browser or operating system vendor (some voices in Chrome are online Google voices). Kolo receives no audio.

blocks.note: **Visible to other users:** your username and daily puzzle scores appear on the leaderboard for signed-in users, and an uploaded profile photo can be opened by anyone who has its link. Your word sets and progress stay private.

sections.title: International transfers
blocks: Some providers process data outside the European Economic Area, including in the United States. These transfers rely on safeguards under Chapter V of the GDPR, such as the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework for certified providers or the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.title: Security

list: All traffic between your device and Kolo is encrypted (HTTPS/TLS).
Google encrypts data stored in Firebase at rest.
Database rules let only you read and change your own profile and word sets.
Passwords are handled by Firebase Authentication; we never have access to them.

blocks: No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your data and will inform you as required by law if a breach affects you.

list: Account and learning data: as long as your account exists.
When you delete your account in the app (More → Settings), your login, profile, word sets and username are deleted right away.
Daily puzzle scores and an uploaded profile photo are **not yet removed automatically** when you delete your account. Email {email.privacy} and we will delete them within 30 days.
Support messages: as long as needed to handle your request. You can ask us to delete them.
Technical logs at our providers: according to their retention periods.
Data in your browser: until you clear it or sign out.

sections.title: Your rights
blocks: Under the GDPR you have the right to:

list: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Correct inaccurate data — you can edit your name, username and photo in your profile.
Delete your data — you can delete your account in More → Settings.
Take your data with you — you can export your word sets in More → Settings.
Restrict or object to processing based on our legitimate interests.
Withdraw consent at any time where we rely on it, for example in Cookie settings.

blocks: Use the tools in the app or email {email.privacy}. We reply within one month.
You can also complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority, [Datatilsynet](https://www.datatilsynet.no/en/), or to the data protection authority in the country where you live.

sections.title: Children
blocks: Kolo is not intended for children under 13. You must be at least 13 — or older if the law in your country requires it to agree on your own — to create an account. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact {email.privacy} and we will delete it.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
blocks: If we change this policy, we will update the effective date. For material changes we will also notify you in the app before they take effect.

sections.title: Contact
blocks: Privacy questions and requests: {email.privacy}. General support: {email.support}.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.scope: Applies to the Kolo Sets website and web app
summary: All learning features are free. Paid extras, if they ever appear, will be optional.
Your word sets belong to you. Export or delete them whenever you want.
Be respectful: no offensive usernames or photos, no abuse of the service.

sections.title: Agreement
blocks: These Terms of Use (“Terms”) are an agreement between you and **{operator}** (“we”, “us”) about your use of Kolo Sets (“Kolo”). By creating an account or using Kolo, you accept these Terms. If you don't agree, please don't use Kolo.
How we handle personal data is explained in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy) and the [Cookie Policy](/cookies).

sections.title: The service
blocks: Kolo is a web application for learning vocabulary in foreign languages with flashcards, spaced repetition (SM-2), quizzes, games and progress tracking.

All learning features are free of charge. We may introduce optional paid add-ons in the future. Kolo will remain fully usable for learning without them, and the price and terms of any add-on will be shown before you buy. Refunds are covered by the [Refund Policy](/refund).

list: You must be at least 13 years old, or older if the law in your country requires it to accept these Terms on your own.
Give accurate information when you sign up and keep your login details safe.
You are responsible for activity under your account. Tell us right away if you suspect unauthorized use.

sections.title: Usernames, photos and the leaderboard
blocks: Your username and daily puzzle scores are visible to other signed-in users, and a profile photo you upload can be opened by anyone who has its link. Don't choose a username or photo that is offensive, misleading, impersonates someone or infringes anyone's rights. We may change or remove a username or photo that breaks these rules.

sections.title: Acceptable use
blocks: You agree not to:

list: Try to gain unauthorized access to Kolo, other accounts or our infrastructure.
Use Kolo to distribute spam, malware or illegal content.
Use bots or scripts that overload Kolo or manipulate the leaderboard.
Impersonate another person or organization.
Upload content that violates the law or the rights of others.
You own the word sets, cards and other content you create.
You give us a limited, non-exclusive license to store, process and display your content only to provide Kolo — for example, to sync your sets and show your username on the leaderboard.
You are responsible for making sure your content doesn't infringe copyrights or other rights.
You can export your sets or delete your account at any time in More → Settings.

sections.title: Our content
blocks: The Kolo app, its code, design, logo and brand, and the word sets we publish belong to us or our licensors. You may use them for personal, non-commercial learning. Please don't copy, resell or redistribute them without our permission.

list: For learning, Kolo gives XP, levels, weekly orbits and shields, capsules, virtual items (satellites, ring colours, titles, profile backgrounds), stardust and medals. They exist only inside Kolo and make learning more fun.
Virtual items have no monetary value. They can't be sold, transferred to another account or exchanged for money or anything outside Kolo. We don't sell capsules, items or stardust.
What a capsule contains is random. The odds are shown in the app before you open it.

An item gives you a personal right to use it in Kolo, not ownership. We may adjust rewards, for example to fix a mistake; if we remove an item you already have, we will try to replace it with an equivalent one.
Rewards gained by cheating or abusing the service may be removed.
When you delete your account, your rewards are deleted too and can't be restored.
We work to keep Kolo running, but we can't promise it will always be available or free of errors.
We may change, add or remove features. If we decide to shut Kolo down, we will try to give advance notice so you can export your data.
We recommend exporting your sets regularly as a backup.
Kolo is a learning tool; we can't guarantee specific learning results.

blocks.note: Nothing in these Terms limits your rights as a consumer under mandatory law, or our liability where the law does not allow it to be limited.

sections.title: Ending the agreement
blocks: **By you:** you can stop using Kolo and delete your account at any time in More → Settings.
**By us:** we may suspend or close an account that seriously or repeatedly breaks these Terms. Where reasonable, we will warn you first and explain why.

sections.title: Changes to these Terms
blocks: We may update these Terms. We will change the effective date and, for material changes, notify you in the app before they take effect. If you don't agree with the new Terms, you can delete your account before they apply.

sections.title: Governing law
blocks: These Terms are governed by the laws of Norway, and disputes go to the courts of Norway. If you are a consumer in the EU/EEA, you keep the protection of the mandatory consumer laws of your country and may bring a claim where you live.

sections.title: Contact
blocks: Legal questions: {email.legal}. General support: {email.support}.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.scope: Applies to the Kolo Sets website and web app
summary: We only store what Kolo needs to work and to remember your settings.
You can review your choice at any time in Cookie settings.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
blocks: Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. Similar technologies include **localStorage**, **IndexedDB** and the **Cache Storage** used by installable web apps. In this policy, “cookies” covers all of them.
Under EU/EEA rules — in Norway, the Electronic Communications Act — storage that is strictly necessary for a service you ask for doesn't require consent. Anything else needs your consent first.

sections.title: Strictly necessary storage
blocks: Kolo uses only first-party storage of this kind:

rows: Cache Storage of the installable app: faster loading and offline use.
Until the app updates or you clear it
A local copy of your word sets and profile for speed and offline use, sync status and the order of your sets.
Your progress in the daily puzzle.
Your daily goal, reminder, sound and layout preferences.
Remembers that you've seen the welcome tour or closed a notice.

sections.title: Third-party cookies
blocks: If you choose **Sign in with Google**, Google sets its own cookies on its sign-in pages (for example, accounts.google.com and the Firebase sign-in domain kolo-sets.firebaseapp.com) to sign you in securely. They are governed by [Google's cookie policy](https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies). Kolo sets no other third-party cookies.

sections.title: Analytics and advertising

blocks.note: Kolo currently uses **no analytics and no advertising cookies**.

blocks: If we add analytics in the future (for example, Google Analytics for Firebase), it will run only after you allow it in Cookie settings, and we will update this policy before it starts.

list: Change or withdraw your consent at any time: [open Cookie settings](#cookie-settings). The same link is in the footer.
You can also delete Kolo's data in your browser's site settings. This signs you out and removes anything stored only on this device, such as unsynced sets.

sections.title: Changes
blocks: If we change how Kolo uses cookies, we will update this page and, where consent is needed, ask you again.

sections.title: Contact
blocks: Questions about cookies: {email.privacy}. More about personal data in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.scope: Applies to any payments related to Kolo Sets
summary: Kolo is free. There is nothing to pay for right now — and so nothing to refund.
If paid extras appear, you will see the price and refund terms before buying.
Your statutory consumer rights always apply.

sections.title: Kolo is free
blocks: Kolo currently has **no paid features, subscriptions or in-app purchases**. We don't take payments, so there is nothing to refund.

blocks.note: Kolo never asks for payment details. If someone asks you to pay for Kolo, it isn't us — please tell us at {email.support}.

sections.title: If we introduce paid extras
blocks: We may offer optional paid add-ons in the future. Learning in Kolo will remain fully possible without them (see the [Terms of Use](/terms)). Before any add-on goes on sale, we will update this policy with its exact refund terms. In any case:

list: Before you pay, you will see the price, what is included and, for subscriptions, how to cancel.
If you are a consumer in the EU/EEA, including Norway, you generally have a 14-day right of withdrawal for purchases made online.
For digital content or services that start immediately, this right can only be lost or reduced if you expressly ask for immediate access and confirm at checkout that you understand this.

sections.title: Purchases through app stores
blocks: If paid add-ons are ever sold through the Apple App Store or Google Play, refunds for those purchases are handled by the store under its own refund policy.

sections.title: Something went wrong?
blocks: If you believe you were charged in connection with Kolo, write to {email.support} and describe what happened. We will look into it and get back to you.

sections.title: Contact
blocks: Questions about payments or refunds: {email.support}.
